excerpt: Following the successful small-scale demonstration of tritium spectroscopy using waveguides, Project 8 is now entering Phase III, which aims to scale the CRES technique to a cubic-meter volume, develop an atomic tritium source, and achieve sub-eV sensitivity to the neutrino mass.
title: Overview of the Project 8 Neutrino Mass Experiment (APS DNP Fall Meeting 2025 abstract, 19 October 2025)
